## Core AI & Engineering Specializations
- **Generative AI & Agentic Systems:** Multi-step LLM orchestration, tool calling, structured outputs, grounded RAG pipelines (Google Gemini API, NotebookLM-style knowledge indexing).
- **Edge & Real-Time ML:** Quantized TensorFlow Lite computer vision pipelines running at 60 FPS on edge/IoT hardware with 75% model footprint reduction.
- **Spatial Web & Frontend Architecture:** React, TypeScript, Next.js, Three.js / React Three Fiber (WebGL), instanced rendering, custom GLSL shaders, and Core Web Vitals optimization.
- **Full-Stack & Data Infrastructure:** Node.js, FastAPI, Python, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Row Level Security), WebSockets.

## Featured Production Systems
- **AeroFolio 3D:** Spatial 3D portfolio merging WebGL with a Gemini-powered Neural Assistant capable of toggling between grounded NotebookLM knowledge-base retrieval and open general AI reasoning.
- **Neural Vision Edge:** Serverless edge computer vision architecture performing 60 FPS object detection on IoT devices using custom quantization pipelines.
- **EcoData Geospatial:** High-throughput telemetry dashboard rendering millions of real-time climate points via WebGL instancing and WebSockets.
- **CryptoSentinel DeFi:** Automated smart contract security auditor predicting liquidity exploits from historical on-chain data.
- **Royal Vision Suite:** Full-stack optical healthcare ERP managing clinical exams, automated scheduling, inventory, and real-time billing with PostgreSQL RLS.
